report.source_text: A renal biopsy was performed. Light microscopy showed that 8/34 glomeruli were sclerotic and the rest showed segmental mesangial deposits and infiltration of neutrophils, but no mesangial cell or stromal proliferation. The glomerular basement membrane was diffusely thickened with segmental spikes. The renal interstitium contained some inflammatory infiltrates, and the tubules showed small focal atrophy and scattered proteinaceous and red blood cell casts. There was intimal fibrous proliferation and sclerosis of small arteries. Congo red stain for amyloid was negative. Direct immunofluorescence showed full-house staining along the mesangium and the capillary loops with subepithelial immune deposits of IgG (3 +), IgA (+), IgM (1 +), C3 (2 +), C1q (1 +), fibrinogen (2 +), albumin (−), kappa (2 +), lambda (3 +).

clinician.final_diagnosis: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) with Class V membranous lupus nephritis
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 38-year-old North African female presented with lower extremity edema, photosensitive erythematous patches with fine scaling on the neck, face, and chest, amenorrhea for one year, and constitutional symptoms (asthenia, 3 kg weight loss). Initial workup revealed nephrotic-range proteinuria (4.5 g/day), hematuria, and hypoalbuminemia. Serological evaluation demonstrated high-titer ANA (1:1800, homogeneous pattern), positive anti-dsDNA (1:40), positive anti-Sm (++), positive anti-RNP (++), positive anti-SSA, and hypocomplementemia (C3 42 mg/L, C4 7 mg/dL). Skin biopsy confirmed lupus erythematosus tumidus with lymphohistiocytic infiltrates, dermal mucin, and CD3/CD4 lymphocytes on direct immunofluorescence. Renal biopsy revealed diffuse glomerular basement membrane thickening with segmental spikes, segmental mesangial deposits, and subepithelial immune complex deposits showing full-house immunofluorescence positivity (IgG 3+, IgA +, IgM 1+, C3 2+, C1q 1+, fibrinogen 2+, kappa 2+, lambda 3+), consistent with membranous lupus nephritis. Follow-up over 22 months demonstrated treatment response with proteinuria reduction from 4.5 g/day to 684 mg/day.
